designAnswers.q1_whereRepresentedAndChecked: Represented as the roadmap.json node field githubReviewGate on the nine R2.camp-0..8 nodes (lines above) and nowhere else: a node scan printed exactly nine gates, all CAMP. Checked at validate-roadmap.mjs:285-291 only; the single failure message is '<id> has invalid CAMP GitHub review gate' (:290) plus 'missing CAMP node: <id>' (:286). No other node's githubReviewGate is read.
designAnswers.q2_soloShape: A solo gate is the existing record with soloException: true, nonAuthor: false, a new head field (40-hex) and a ruling object { ruledHead, pr, commentId, author, bodySha256 } using the packet ruling field names. 'That exact head' is the gate's head field: today exactHead is a boolean policy flag (roadmap.json:3187 'exactHead': true, meaning the approval must be bound to the exact PR head) and no gate names a head, so a solo gate names the head its exception covers in head, and ruling.ruledHead must equal it. exactHead stays true. Fields still required on a solo gate: state APPROVED, exactHead true, nonDismissed true, permissions WRITE/MAINTAIN/ADMIN, because the sentence relaxes only nonAuthor (to false, under soloException true) and adds the ruling as a further requirement; option (b)'s text amends the pin only 'to accept a declared solo-maintainer exception, proved by a head-bound OWNER-RULING' and names no other relaxation. Ruling field rules: ruledHead 40-hex, pr integer, commentId integer, author non-empty string, bodySha256 64-hex. soloException true with nonAuthor true stays refused by the pin, as today.
designAnswers.q3_currentLedgerSolo: Measured: none. All nine gates carry soloException false and nonAuthor true (node scan of roadmap.json), so the change is behaviour-preserving on main; the plain, --git and --next runs are expected to print the same lines.

designAnswers.q5_authorityRisk: The check trusts the gate record and its ruling object; it does not read PK-camp-review-gate's decision. The packet is cited in the check's comment and in the no-ruling failure message. The packet's decision is recorded on main (units.json:8718-8723) and GOAL.md:48 forbids agents from writing the OWNER-RULING comment, label or packet decision; the validator cannot prove a ruling comment exists without GitHub, as for packet rulings today. Reading the decision would be about three more lines in the ledger section (fail when any gate is solo and PK-camp-review-gate.decision.option does not start with '(b)'); it is not in the sentence, so it is left to the parent.

risksForTheParent: Authority: the exception is the owner's declared decision on the CAMP gates (PK-camp-review-gate decision 2026-09-22T22:15:03Z). The validator trusts a solo gate's ruling object and does not read the packet decision (q5); an agent-written solo gate with a fabricated ruling would pass locally, as a fabricated packet ruling does today. There is no --github check of a gate ruling.

GitHub refuses an APPROVED review from a PR's own author, so on a one-collaborator repository a solo head cannot get a real APPROVED review; the gate keeps state APPROVED because the sentence relaxes only nonAuthor. U60's roster P.2 delta must say what APPROVED means under the exception.
PK-camp-review-gate's question cites validate-roadmap.mjs:273 for the pin; on the baseline it is :290 (U41/U42 shifted it). Text drift only.

The packet carries a decision, ruling null and blocks []; U59 is authority class, so from local-verified on validate-roadmap.mjs:484 requires a packet naming U59 in blocks. The parent must add U59 to a packet's blocks when folding the local receipt, or the ledger fails.

The journey-qc spec delta (openspec/changes/add-saved-custom-unit-campaign-roster/specs/journey-qc/spec.md:5) already carries a 2026-08-09 'solo-maintainer reduction' with a sentinel approval tuple 'solo-maintainer|<owner-login>'; U60 amends P.2 and should reconcile with it. Read-only here.
